description: Neryva Engine knowledge-plane vector search indexes (P4). Code-managed: this file is the source of truth for the Atlas Search indexes the atlas-vector-search backend requires. Apply with the Atlas CLI/API (e.g. `atlas clusters search indexes create`), never click-ops. Bump `version` and add a new definition entry when the index shape changes; the backend references indexes by name.

indexes.name: ix_embeddings_vector
notes: numDimensions MUST equal the engine's EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS (src/modules/knowledge/schema.ts). A model change requires a new index version and a re-embed.
similarity=cosine matches the port's score contract (higher = more similar, pgvector `1 - (embedding <=> query)` semantics).

organization_id / model / chunk_id are declared as filter fields so the backend's pre-filter (tenant + model + admitted chunk set) executes inside the $vectorSearch stage — authorization-before-scoring.
organization_id and chunk_id are stored as BSON Binary subtype 4 (UUID); the backend passes Binary values in the filter.
